Pancho walks 20 miles a day. Except on weekends when he walks 10 miles. How many miles does he walk in a week?
In a week, there are 5 working days and 2 weekend days.
So, the number of miles Pancho walks in a week = (5 × 20) + (2 × 10)
= 100 + 20
= 120 miles
Therefore, Pancho walks 120 miles in a week. - Mathematics
